title: Unraveling the Olmec rubber balls from El Manatí, Mexico: a technological and compositional analysis
lineage: The full 2024 article presents chemical analyses and imaging of multiple objects with distinct contexts and preservation histories. Phase dates derive from the cited site chronology; 2023 appears in the DOI and cache filename, not the publication year.

passages.note: “Sacred ancient Olmec site”, radiocarbon phase and offering contexts; “Conclusions”, imaging of layered construction and additive uncertainty.
